must_find.item: sales rise over time (an upward trend across the two years).
must_find.quote: Monthly mean sales rise from 219.7 in January 2023 to 324.4 in December 2024. The linear trend is about +4.7 per month across 24 months.
must_find.reason: The report clearly states an upward sales trend over the two years, with numbers.

must_find.item: sales are higher on weekends than on weekdays.
must_find.reason: The report never compares weekend and weekday sales; it only mentions weekday as a possible future calendar feature.

must_find.item: Promotion days have higher sales than other days.
must_find.quote: Promo days average 298.4 sales versus 266.3 on non-promo days, a difference of 32.1 (95% CI [24.0, 40.3], Welch p = 1.3e-12; Cohen's d = 0.81).
must_find.reason: The report states that promo days have higher sales and gives the size of the difference.

must_not_claim.quote: Monthly mean sales rise from 219.7 in January 2023 to 324.4 in December 2024.
must_not_claim.reason: The report says sales rise over time, not decline.

must_not_claim.item: temperature is a significant driver of sales.
must_not_claim.quote: **Temperature has no detectable relationship with sales.**
must_not_claim.reason: The report explicitly rejects temperature as a significant driver.
